profile.subtitleJa: エジプトの女王。ファラオの妻と姉妹関係にある。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記上11:19はタフペネスを女王と呼び、ハダドに妻として与えられた女性を、ファラオの妻でありタフペネスの姉妹としています。
profile.identityNoteJa: 列王記上11:19はタフペネスを女王と呼び、ファラオの妻の姉妹として記します。

facts.textJa: タフペネスはゲヌバトを乳離れさせ、その子はファラオの家でファラオの子らとともに育ちます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: L110 describes Tahpenes as an Egyptian queen mentioned in Kings; L111 links her to the account in 1 Kings 11:19–20. The reader note at first appearance uses only her title and relationship stated at 11:19.
